lines.text: T. rex's closest living relatives? Chickens.
lines.caption: T. rex's closest living relatives? Chickens.

lines.text: The proof hid inside a bone. Wait for it.
Birds don't just look like dinosaurs. They are dinosaurs.
Scientists studied a sixty-eight-million-year-old T. rex thighbone with traces of protein.
lines.caption: Scientists studied a 68-million-year-old T. rex thighbone with traces of protein.

lines.text: They compared its collagen protein with living animals.
The best matches? Not lizards. Not alligators. Chickens and ostriches!
So that chicken? It's a tiny cousin of T. rex.
